purpose: bounded no-collision-only causal link-state estimator comparison
oracle: analysis-only true-state momentum observer from tools/analysis_wrench.py; never fed production
bias_for_isolation: disabled in every candidate; comparison isolates V

metrics.primary: mean force RMSE against oracle across 3 masses x 3 windows
metrics.secondary: mean absolute error of positive Fz peak across the same windows
metrics.guard: no individual force-RMSE window may exceed current by more than 10%

selection: lowest primary metric among guarded candidates; tie within 0.1% chooses lower secondary, then current
adoption: no production edit unless selected candidate beats current primary and secondary; any adoption requires fresh collision-blind symmetric T calibration before collision testing
